name: Tirnach Vault 152 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Growing Area: Offers a spacious 13.2 square meters of planting space, ideal for maximizing yield in home gardens, greenhouses, or commercial setups. Commercial Growers: Supports small-scale commercial operations seeking to increase output and reduce labor through efficient, scalable planting solutions. description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Growing Area: Offers a spacious 13.2 square meters of planting space, ideal for maximizing yield in home gardens, greenhouses, or commercial setups.
  • Optimized Root Zone Temperature: Maintains a consistent root zone temperature of 25°C, promoting healthy root development and supporting robust plant growth.
  • High Capacity: Equipped with 154 individual plant slots, allowing for efficient cultivation of multiple crops or plant varieties in a single unit.
  • Extended Growing Season: Supports a growing cycle of up to 231 days, enabling long-term cultivation and increased harvest opportunities.
  • Passive Capillary Irrigation: Utilizes a passive capillary irrigation system, ensuring even moisture distribution to all plants while reducing manual watering needs and minimizing water waste.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price determined upon acceptance, providing flexibility for bulk orders or tailored solutions.

Main Benefits

  • Maximized Productivity: The large planting area and high slot count allow users to grow a diverse selection of herbs, vegetables, or flowers, increasing overall output per season.
  • Consistent Plant Health: Stable root temperature and reliable irrigation reduce plant stress, resulting in stronger, healthier plants with higher survival rates.
  • Water-Efficient Operation: The passive capillary system conserves water by delivering moisture directly to plant roots, supporting sustainable gardening practices.
  • Reduced Maintenance: Automated irrigation and optimal temperature control minimize daily upkeep, making this planter suitable for both beginners and experienced growers.
  • Extended Use: With a 231-day cycle, this planter supports year-round or multi-season growing, meeting the needs of users seeking continuous harvests.

Typical Use Cases & Outcomes

  • Home Gardeners: Ideal for individuals looking to expand their home vegetable or herb garden with minimal maintenance and reliable results.
  • Urban and Indoor Farming: Suited for greenhouse or indoor environments where space optimization, water efficiency, and temperature control are essential.
  • Educational or Community Projects: Provides a practical solution for schools, community gardens, or research projects requiring easy-to-manage, high-capacity growing systems.
  • Commercial Growers: Supports small-scale commercial operations seeking to increase output and reduce labor through efficient, scalable planting solutions.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is this planter easy to set up and use?
    Yes, the passive capillary irrigation system is designed for ease of use, requiring minimal setup and maintenance.
  • Is it compatible with different plant types?
    The 154 plant slots accommodate a wide range of plant species, from leafy greens and herbs to flowers and small vegetables.
  • How durable is the unit?
    Built for extended use over a 231-day cycle, the planter is suitable for both indoor and outdoor environments, ensuring reliability throughout the growing season.
  • What is the pricing structure?
    Pricing is determined after acceptance, allowing for customized solutions based on your specific needs and order size.
